elderly parents and I attended an appointment on a cold and rainy morning.

Despite arriving only 7 minutes late and apologising, we were met with no empathy from either the GP or the receptionist.

The receptionist was dismissive, unfriendly, and argued about whether we were 7 or 10 minutes late, showing no understanding of the circumstances or my parents’ needs.

The GP reluctantly agreed to see us and repeatedly commented that our lateness would impact the next appointment, even though the waiting room was empty.
